documents.pageSubtitle: Searchable, version-controlled organizational repository with authorized workflow sign-offs.

documents.initialDraftNotice: Draft document not yet submitted to the review workflow.

documents.changeNotesRequired: Change notes are required to explain what was modified in this revision.
documents.approveDesc: Certifies this document as an approved organization record available to authorized staff.

documents.commentsRequiredOnReject: Review comments explaining the decision are mandatory when requesting amendments or rejecting.

documents.archiveConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to archive {{ref}}? Archived records will be hidden from general searches and marked as historical records.
documents.restoreConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to restore {{ref}}? It will be returned to active draft status.
